lines.en: Welcome to the hall. This old bridge in the photograph was built in 1900, and it is still used every day.
lines.pt: Bem-vinda ao salão. Esta velha ponte na fotografia foi construída em 1900 e ainda é usada todos os dias.

lines.en: Really? It looks much older. Who designed it, and was it built by local workers or by a company?
lines.pt: Sério? Parece muito mais antiga. Quem a projetou, e ela foi construída por operários locais ou por uma empresa?

lines.en: It was designed by an engineer from Scotland, and about two hundred workers were hired to build it.
lines.pt: Foi projetada por um engenheiro da Escócia, e cerca de duzentos operários foram contratados para construí-la.

lines.en: Two hundred is a lot. How long did the construction take, and was it difficult in those days?
lines.pt: Duzentos é muita gente. Quanto tempo durou a construção, e foi difícil naquela época?

lines.en: It took almost four years. Many materials were brought by train, and the work was stopped twice because of floods.
lines.pt: Durou quase quatro anos. Muitos materiais foram trazidos de trem, e a obra foi interrompida duas vezes por causa de enchentes.

lines.en: Floods? I did not know that. When was the bridge opened to the public, then?
lines.pt: Enchentes? Eu não sabia. Quando a ponte foi aberta ao público, então?

lines.en: It was opened in the spring of 1904. In the twentieth century, it was repaired three times, and it was widened once.
lines.pt: Foi aberta na primavera de 1904. No século vinte, ela foi reparada três vezes e foi alargada uma vez.

lines.en: Amazing. My grandfather grew up near here, so he may have crossed it as a boy. He never told me much.
lines.pt: Incrível. Meu avô cresceu perto daqui, então ele pode ter atravessado a ponte quando era menino. Nunca me contou muito.

lines.en: That is quite possible. Many families moved to this city in the early 1900s because the railway was built nearby.
lines.pt: É bem possível. Muitas famílias se mudaram para esta cidade no início dos anos 1900 porque a ferrovia foi construída por perto.

lines.en: I would love to see old pictures. Are any photographs from that period kept in the museum here?
lines.pt: Eu adoraria ver fotos antigas. Há fotografias daquele período guardadas no museu daqui?

lines.en: Yes, there is a whole room. It was opened last year, and I can take you there right now.
lines.pt: Sim, há uma sala inteira. Ela foi inaugurada no ano passado, e posso levá-la lá agora mesmo.

facts.big: was built in 1900 · was designed by · the twentieth century
facts.label: Contar a história de um lugar
facts.sub: Use o passado simples e o passivo com datas e séculos.

facts.label: was/were + particípio
facts.sub: The bridge was built in 1900. Two hundred workers were hired. O agente (by + pessoa) só aparece se for importante: It was designed by an engineer.

facts.label: in + ano
facts.sub: Use in com anos, meses e séculos: in 1900, in spring, in the twentieth century. Para uma data exata, use on: on May 3rd.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A century has one hundred years.
items.why: The twentieth century was from 1901 to 2000.

items.s: In 1900 is correct for a year; on 1900 is wrong.
items.why: Use in with years and centuries.

items.s: The passive voice is often used to talk about history.
items.why: The action matters more than the person.

answers: A century has one hundred years. → Verdadeiro (The twentieth century was from 1901 to 2000.)
In 1900 is correct for a year; on 1900 is wrong. → Verdadeiro (Use in with years and centuries.)
The passive voice is often used to talk about history. → Verdadeiro (The action matters more than the person.)

pages.title: The bridge was built in 1900 · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday in Atlanta. Clara walks into an old stone hall. On the wall, there is a large photograph. Blake, the guide, stands beside it. The picture shows a bridge from long ago. Clara wants to know its story.

“Welcome to the hall. This old bridge in the photograph was built in 1900, and it is still used every day.” says Blake. “Really? It looks much older. Who designed it, and was it built by local workers or by a company?” says Clara. “It was designed by an engineer from Scotland, and about two hundred workers were hired to build it.” says Blake.
